def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c, v in cells), max(r for r, c, v in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c, v in cells), max(c for r, c, v in cells)
    outer = grid[r0][c0]
    inner_cells = [(r, c) for r, c, v in cells if v != outer]
    ir0, ir1 = min(r for r, c in inner_cells), max(r for r, c in inner_cells)
    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r, c in inner_cells), max(c for r, c in inner_cells)
    ih, iw = ir1 - ir0 + 1, ic1 - ic0 + 1
    radius = ih if ih == iw else 2
    color = grid[inner_cells[0][0]][inner_cells[0][1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0-radius), min(h, r1+radius+1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0-radius), min(w, c1+radius+1)):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
